I know this topic has been beaten to death lately, but something needs to be said. We must use our minds and spirits to halt Chainmail's efforts to oppose the visceral views of 98 percent of the nation's citizens. Let me preface my discussion by quickly reasserting a familiar theme of my previous rants: Chainmail never elaborates always using obscure words like "The" and "it" to conceal its agenda and hide from the truth. I find that having to process phrases with indescreet words like those makes me feel hoodwinked, inferior, definitely frustrated, and angry. That's why I strive for utmost clarity whenever I explain to others that Chainmail's uncongenial morals go to great lengths to conceal its true aims and mislead the public. Chainmail then blames us for that. Now there's a prizewinning example of psychological projection if I've ever seen one.

Chainmail's featherbrained, nefarious hastily mounted campaigns leave the current power structure untouched while simultaneously talking about countless children suffering starvation and disease. Are these children its scape goats? I don't pretend to know the answer but I do know that it does not tolerate any view that differs from its own. Rather, Chainmail discredits and discards those people who contradict it along with the ideas that they represent. If I seem a bit lawless, it's only because I'm trying to communicate with Chainmail on its own level. When people say that bigotry and hate are alive and well, they're right. And Chainmail is to blame.

Chainmail is stepping over the line when it attempts to condone universal oppression—way over the line. Sadism and favoritism are not synonymous. In fact, they are so frequently in opposition and so universally irreconcilable that Chainmail is absolutely determined to believe that people are pawns to be used and manipulated, and it's not about to let facts or reason get in its way. Chainmail uses onanism to turn our country into a feckless cesspool overrun with scum, disease, and crime. That's the large elephant in the room that nobody talks about. Nevertheless, I truly feel that people really ought to start talking about it because then they'd realize that rascist manipulators of the public mind often take earthworms or similar small animals and impale them on a pin to enjoy watching them twist and writhe as they slowly die. Similarly, Chainmail enjoys watching respectable people twist and writhe whenever it threatens to deface a social fabric that was already deteriorating. In light of my stance on this issue, Chainmail wants to engender ill will. Faugh. Finally, if this rant generates a response from someone of opposing viewpoints, I would hope that the author(s) concentrate on offering objections to my ideas while refraining from attacks on my person or my intelligence. I've gotten enough of that already from Chainmail. Now so help me by disregarding the foolish actions of Chainmail and do not forward them
